verdict.rationale: Warp's docs and launch blog say its client source code is published at github.com/warpdotdev/warp under AGPL v3, an OSI-approved open license. The GitHub repo itself, with an open-contribution issue process, and a community comment on the open-source release independently confirm the code is readable. The older "closed-source" jab is general sentiment and does not counter the documented release. Missing for 10: the open-sourced scope is only the client (cloud/agent backend source is not evidenced as open), and the release reportedly lacks commit history.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Read and audit Warp’s client source code at warpdotdev/warp, open source under AGPL v3
